_documentation: Map of shadcn component name → array of structural signals to skip in scripts/audit-patterns/shadcn.ts. Use this only for documented intentional deviations from the canonical shadcn registry. Each entry should have a comment explaining why. Pattern: "<component>": ["import:<source>" | "export:<name>" | "data-slot:<value>"].

_examples._button-comment: Example: skip the Slot import drift if we forked Button to use a different slot lib.

sonner._comment: The canonical sonner.tsx casts `theme` as `ToasterProps['theme']`, which includes `undefined`. The template's tsconfig sets `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true`, which rejects `undefined` for an optional prop. We narrow to the literal union `'light' | 'dark' | 'system'` instead. The structural diff doesn't currently inspect class names or expression bodies, so this is documentary; the entry is here so a future class-name diff doesn't surface it as drift.
